rationale.consistency: Follows surrounding idioms: cmdutil.MutuallyExclusive/FlagErrorf, ctx.Background(), Copy() with RepoDir, same ff-only warning text as in-place checkout, heredoc help and backticked `path` placeholder.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers blank/--list/--checkout validation, relative->absolute, spaces via arg slices, reuse-vs-new worktree, existing-vs-new branch, cross-repo remote via branchRepo; resolves target before creating the linked branch.
rationale.scope: Required move into pr/shared done; but localBranchExists silently switched from show-ref to HasLocalBranch (rev-parse) and a new exported WorktreeCheckoutCommands was added beyond the ask.
rationale.readability: Clear switch in checkoutBranchInWorktree and well-commented shared helpers; AddWorktree's empty-remote mode switch is slightly implicit but documented.
rationale.robustness: Errors propagated, Abs failures handled, path safety checks kept (symlink/non-dir), Pull failure degrades to a warning like the existing flow; no panics on odd input.
rationale.maintainability: worktree-add argument construction now lives in three places (git.AddWorktree, shared.WorktreeCheckoutCommands, cmdsForMissingRemote), so develop and pr checkout don't actually share the git helper; Abs is computed twice.
